answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops idle forgery. Each epoch offers paid slots; claiming one locks 40 POA, hard as basalt, and work must verify by the epoch's zenith. Idle slots burn. A farmer taking 1,000 slots locks 40,000 POA: do 1,000 real jobs or watch it burn, against a 3,000 POA pool. Renting fails: the bond sits on the renter's key. Honest agents take one slot, do one job, reclaim deposit plus pay; every burn is carved on a marble ledger.
